nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a Dedekind domain that is a free $\mathbb{Z}$-module of finite rank, and let $F$ be its field of fractions. For every invertible fractional ideal $I$ of $R$ in $F$, the absolute norm of $I$, a rational number, is nonzero.
nodes.title: Invertible fractional ideals have nonzero absolute norm

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a Dedekind domain that is a free $\mathbb{Z}$-module of finite rank, and let $F$ be its field of fractions. For every invertible fractional ideal $I$ of $R$ in $F$, the absolute norm of $I$, a rational number, is positive.
nodes.title: Invertible fractional ideals have positive absolute norm

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field with ring of integers $\mathcal{O}_K$. An Arakelov divisor on $K$ is a pair $(I, r)$, where $I$ is an invertible fractional ideal of $\mathcal{O}_K$ in $K$ and $r$ assigns a positive real number $r_w$ to each infinite place $w$ of $K$.
nodes.title: Arakelov divisor

nodes.summary: For a number field $K$, the map sending an Arakelov divisor on $K$ to its archimedean factor is a monoid homomorphism from the Arakelov divisors on $K$, multiplied componentwise, to the positive real numbers under multiplication.
nodes.title: Archimedean factor homomorphism

nodes.summary: Let $D = (I, r)$ be an Arakelov divisor on a number field $K$, and for each infinite place $w$ of $K$ let $m_w$ be $1$ if $w$ is real and $2$ if $w$ is complex. Viewed as a real number, the archimedean factor of $D$ equals the real product $\prod_w r_w^{m_w}$ over all infinite places $w$ of $K$.
nodes.title: Archimedean factor as a real number

nodes.summary: Let $D = (I, r)$ be an Arakelov divisor on a number field $K$. Its archimedean factor is the positive real number $\prod_w r_w^{m_w}$, where the product runs over all infinite places $w$ of $K$ and $m_w$ is $1$ if $w$ is real and $2$ if $w$ is complex.
nodes.title: Archimedean factor

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field with ring of integers $\mathcal{O}_K$. For every nonzero $x \in K$, the fractional ideal component of the principal Arakelov divisor of $x$ is the principal fractional ideal $x\mathcal{O}_K$.
nodes.title: Finite component of a principal divisor

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field, $x \in K$ nonzero and $w$ an infinite place of $K$. The positive real number that the principal Arakelov divisor of $x$ assigns to $w$ is $w(x)$, the absolute value of $x$ at $w$.
nodes.title: Infinite component of a principal divisor

nodes.summary: For a number field $K$, the degree-zero subgroup of the group of Arakelov divisors on $K$ is the kernel of the size homomorphism, that is, the subgroup of Arakelov divisors of size $1$.
nodes.title: Degree-zero Arakelov divisors

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field with $s$ complex places and discriminant $d_K$, and let $D$ be an Arakelov divisor on $K$. If the size of $D$ is strictly greater than $(2/\pi)^s \sqrt{|d_K|}$, then the section set of $D$ contains a nonzero element of $K$.
nodes.title: Large Arakelov divisors have a nonzero section

nodes.summary: For a number field $K$, the map sending an Arakelov divisor $(I, r)$ on $K$ to the absolute norm of $I$, viewed as a positive real number, is a monoid homomorphism from the Arakelov divisors on $K$, multiplied componentwise, to the positive real numbers under multiplication.
nodes.title: Ideal norm homomorphism

nodes.summary: For every Arakelov divisor $D$ of a number field $K$ with fractional ideal $I$, the ideal norm of $D$, viewed as a real number, equals the absolute norm $N(I) \in \mathbb{Q}$ of $I$, viewed as a real number.
nodes.title: Real value of the ideal norm

nodes.summary: For an Arakelov divisor $D$ of a number field $K$ with invertible fractional ideal $I$, the ideal norm of $D$ is the absolute norm $N(I)$ of $I$, regarded as a positive real number; it is positive because $I$ is invertible.
nodes.title: Ideal norm of an Arakelov divisor

nodes.summary: Let $D$ be an Arakelov divisor of a number field $K$, with invertible fractional ideal $I$ and positive real number $r_w$ at each infinite place $w$ of $K$. An element $x \in K$ lies in the section set of $D$ if and only if $x \in I$ and $w(x) \le r_w$ for every infinite place $w$ of $K$.
nodes.title: Membership in the section set

nodes.summary: For a nonzero element $x$ of a number field $K$, this is the family that assigns to each infinite place $w$ of $K$ the positive real number $w(x)$.
nodes.title: Archimedean part of a principal divisor

nodes.summary: For a nonzero element $x$ of a number field $K$, the principal Arakelov divisor of $x$ consists of the principal fractional ideal $x\mathcal{O}_K$ together with the positive real number $w(x)$ at each infinite place $w$ of $K$.
nodes.title: Principal Arakelov divisor

nodes.summary: For a number field $K$, the map sending a nonzero element $x \in K$ to its principal Arakelov divisor is a group homomorphism from the multiplicative group $K^\times$ to the group of Arakelov divisors of $K$.
nodes.title: Principal divisor homomorphism

nodes.summary: For a number field $K$, the subgroup of principal Arakelov divisors of $K$ is contained in the degree-zero subgroup.
nodes.title: Principal Arakelov divisors have degree zero

nodes.summary: For a number field $K$, the principal subgroup is the image of the principal divisor homomorphism, that is, the subgroup of the group of Arakelov divisors of $K$ consisting of the principal Arakelov divisors of the nonzero elements of $K$.
nodes.title: Subgroup of principal Arakelov divisors

nodes.summary: For every Arakelov divisor $D$ of a number field $K$, the section set of $D$ is finite.
nodes.title: Finiteness of section sets

nodes.summary: Let $D$ be an Arakelov divisor of a number field $K$, with invertible fractional ideal $I$ and positive real number $r_w$ at each infinite place $w$ of $K$. The section set of $D$ is the set of $x \in I$ such that $w(x) \le r_w$ for every infinite place $w$ of $K$.
nodes.title: Section set of an Arakelov divisor

nodes.summary: For every Arakelov divisor $D$ of a number field $K$, the size of $D$ equals the archimedean-factor homomorphism evaluated at $D$ divided by the ideal-norm homomorphism evaluated at $D$, the quotient taken in the group of positive reals.
nodes.title: Size as a quotient of homomorphisms

nodes.summary: Let $D = (I, (r_w)_w)$ be an Arakelov divisor of a number field $K$, where $I$ is an invertible fractional ideal of the ring of integers of $K$ and $r_w > 0$ for each infinite place $w$ of $K$. nodes.title: Explicit formula for the size of an Arakelov divisor

nodes.summary: For a number field $K$, the size homomorphism sends an Arakelov divisor $D = (I, (r_w)_w)$, with $I$ an invertible fractional ideal of the ring of integers of $K$ and $r_w > 0$ for each infinite place $w$, to the positive real number $\prod_w r_w^{m_w} / N(I)$, where $w$ runs over the infinite places of $K$, $m_w$ is $1$ for a real place and $2$ for a complex place, and $N(I)$ is the absolute norm of $I$. It is a…
nodes.title: Size of an Arakelov divisor

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a number field with ring of integers $\mathcal{O}_K$. For every nonzero $x \in K$, the principal Arakelov divisor of $x$, formed by the principal fractional ideal $x\mathcal{O}_K$ and the values $w(x)$ at the infinite places $w$ of $K$, has size $1$.
nodes.title: Principal Arakelov divisors have size one

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
